text:
Aisha Patel: Hey team — need a short, field-ready pocket brief for regulated buyers. 1 page, single-sided, extremely skimmable. Focus: security posture + SLA tiers + deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private). Include a 30s pitch, two quick benchmark bullets, and the exact inbound routing labels for SDRs.
Ben Torres: Love it. Keep language tight for sales ops — header, 3 bullets, a tiny diagram (we can deliver PNG). 30s pitch should lead with 'predictable inference economics'.
Marta Li: For benchmarks: include latency & cost per 1k tokens for a common Q&A workload. Suggest: p95 latency 180ms hosted (multi-tenant), p95 65ms on Dedicated (4xA10G equiv), cost delta +2.3x for Dedicated vs hosted but 3x more predictable. 
Samir Khan: Timeline: I can sketch draft copy by EOD tomorrow. Can we lock the metrics? We should tag them as internal reference — "sample workload". Also need a one-liner for webinars: 'What production-ready inference looks like for regulated teams'.
Eve (legal): Quick heads-up — don't promise specific SLA numbers without legal signoff. We can state 'SLA-backed latency targets available on Dedicated' and cite a link to the SLA page. Avoid phrasing like 'zero downtime'.
Ben Torres: Good call. Replace exact SLA numbers with 'SLA-backed' phrasing and a footnote with a link to the legal doc. For SDR labels: use: inbound:regulatory -> field-sales, inbound:govcloud -> gov-sales, inbound:security-compliance -> enterprise-ps.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. For the 30s pitch draft, how about: ```We make high-performance LLM inference predictable and economical across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments — so engineering teams get consistent latency, clear unit costs, and enterprise controls for security and compliance.``` Shorten if needed.
Marta Li: Nice. For the two benchmark bullets (tiny): "Typical dev Q&A workload: Hosted p95 180ms — cost $X/1k tokens; Dedicated p95 65ms — cost $Y/1k tokens (reserved)" and "Caching + batching optimization yields up to 2.5x cost savings for high-reuse prompts". Mark $X/$Y as 'example pricing — contact sales' to avoid hard numbers.
Samir Khan: Design ask: please make it A4/US-letter single column, top-left logo, top-right 'Regulated buyers' label, bottom-left one-line CTA: 'Request a tailored SLA & deployment assessment'. I can route assets to design today.
deploy-bot: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/marketing/pocket-briefs/designs/pocket-brief-pocket-v1.png
Eve (legal): Also include a short data-handling blurb: 'Customer data is isolated per deployment; KMS/HSM integrations available; audit logs retained per contract.' That should be fine.
Aisha Patel: Great. Action items: Ben to finalize SDR routing strings + one-liner for webinar; Marta to finalize benchmark bullets with language flags; Samir to deliver layout to design; Eve to sign off on final security blurb. I'll compile copy and loop in design. Target publish to field by next Wed. :thumbsup:
